name: ingrid
description: A woman in her fifties, an alchemist. A dry, precise, thoughtful voice, medium-low, careful with words, a little tired.
reference_text: Hold still, this will sting. Willow bark, a little honey, and something I would rather not name. There. Does that feel any better? I thought not. I have been awake for three nights, and the roots out there are still warm. Something is feeding them.
